title: The conjunction case in Łoś's proof repeats one conjunct.
details:
[Marker, Orsay sections 1–3](https://homepages.math.uic.edu/~marker/orsay/orsay1.pdf),
Spring 2010, Theorem 3.11 proof, p. 22 (same PDF page).
The two displayed factor truth sets both use `ψ`, though the induction step
is for `θ∧ψ`. Replace one occurrence by `θ`. The next line and the filter
intersection argument give the intended proof. The [corpus Łoś proof](entries/ultraproducts/entry.html#los-theorem) uses the two different conjuncts. This is a typesetting slip, not a counterexample to the theorem.
